facts.fact: BOCRA says Botswana implemented the One Network Area framework jointly with Malawi, Lesotho, Zambia and Zimbabwe, cutting mobile roaming tariffs by 10% to 98.6%, following the Botswana/Namibia rates of August 2024.

MOZ.note: Document says engagements with Mozambique are ongoing, so no roaming arrangement in effect is stated for it.

facts.fact: BOCRA says Botswana and Namibia were the first in SADC to implement reduced and harmonised roaming rates, in August 2024.
BOCRA says Zambia implemented the One Network Area framework jointly with Botswana, with Botswana operators' roaming data prices to Zambian networks cut by 82% to 93%.
